items.title: Fix the orphan validation-protocol smoke and register it in all three canonical inventories or delete it deliberately
items.context: tasks/validation-protocol-smoke.ts:1229 CASE_MISMATCH assertion fails with undefined; decide whether runManagedAssetCheck fails to detect a case-only filename mismatch on a case-insensitive filesystem or the assertion is wrong; then npm script + test:serial-reference + RESOURCE_POLICY, all three, or a recorded deletion. Also sweep tasks/ for other files no npm script references. RED: run `node packages/main/dist/tasks/validation-protocol-smoke.js` and observe the CASE_MISMATCH assertion fail with actual undefined, then confirm `npm run test:serial-reference` never executes it; GREEN is the assertion passing AND the suite name present in all three inventories, with the full-suite runner refusing a chain member that has no policy row.
items.userSees: `node packages/main/dist/tasks/validation-protocol-smoke.js` ends with its PASS line and `grep -n validation-protocol package.json packages/main/src/tasks/full-suite-runner.ts proof-or-stop.config.json` shows the suite in test:serial-reference, RESOURCE_POLICY and validate.commands; the sweep prints a line per file under packages/main/src/tasks not referenced by any inventory, each marked registered, deleted, or kept-unregistered with a reason.

happy.desc: validation-protocol-smoke passes when run directly and is registered in the npm script chain, RESOURCE_POLICY and validate.commands.

items.title: Give the full-suite membership smoke a real-data case that fails on genuine chain-versus-policy drift
items.context: tasks/full-suite-runner-smoke.ts around line 563 only compares synthetic fixtures. RED: remove a real RESOURCE_POLICY row on a scratch copy and assert the new case fails; account for test:serial-reference-prefix members that legitimately read as stalePolicy against the main chain. Keep the synthetic cases.
items.userSees: `node packages/main/dist/tasks/full-suite-runner-smoke.js` prints a `[PASS] real inventory: every test:serial-reference and test:serial-reference-prefix member has a RESOURCE_POLICY row` line and a `[PASS] real inventory mutation: removing a RESOURCE_POLICY row on a scratch copy fails membership` line, then its final PASS line.

happy.desc: The real package.json chains (test:serial-reference and test:serial-reference-prefix) are evaluated against the real RESOURCE_POLICY and pass on the current tree.

edge.desc: Members of test:serial-reference-prefix are not reported as stalePolicy against the main chain; the synthetic cases remain and still pass.

adversarial.desc: Removing one real RESOURCE_POLICY row on a scratch copy makes the real-data case fail with the row named.

items.title: Extend the RED-before-GREEN guard to finding-fix commits with a marker for legitimate no-RED fixes
items.context: tasks/validation-tier-planner-smoke.ts guard (declaredChecklistItems plus the ^(RED|GREEN)\(CHK-\d{3}\): commit-subject regex) matches only CHK ids. Derive F-nnn ids from git log subjects; require RED(F-nnn) before GREEN(F-nnn) or an explicit no-RED marker with reason for comment-only or registration-only fixes. RED: squash a RED into a GREEN on a scratch branch and assert the guard fails. Consider a shared helper so other stories' suites reuse it.
items.userSees: `node packages/main/dist/tasks/validation-tier-planner-smoke.js` prints `[PASS] RED-before-GREEN guard: every GREEN(CHK-nnn) and GREEN(F-nnn) subject on main..HEAD has a preceding RED or a no-RED marker with a reason` and ends with its PASS line; a scratch branch where a RED(F-nnn) commit is squashed into its GREEN makes the guard fail naming the finding id.

happy.desc: The guard derives CHK-nnn and F-nnn ids from commit subjects on main..HEAD and passes when every GREEN has a preceding RED for the same id.

edge.desc: A GREEN(F-nnn) commit whose body carries the documented no-RED marker with a reason of at least 30 characters passes; a marker without a reason fails.

adversarial.desc: On a scratch branch where the RED(F-nnn) commit is squashed into the GREEN, the guard fails and names the id; the helper in core/red-green-commit-guard.ts is what the smoke calls.

items.title: Persist host B's parsed findings from cross_host_review as structured evidence
items.context: handlers/cross-host-review.ts persists only stdoutDigest; findings exist in memory at diffFindings and findingCount. Persist title/severity/file/desc into the verdict JSON or register them through finding_add with the host as agent so they enter the resolve/dismiss lifecycle; never persist raw provider stdout. RED: a FAIL leaf with two findings must leave their text in a committed artifact.
items.userSees: `node packages/main/dist/tasks/cross-host-review-smoke.js` prints `[PASS] host B findings persisted: a FAIL leaf with two findings leaves title, severity, file and description in the verdict artifact` and its final PASS line; `cross_host_review --json` output includes a findings array for host B with no raw stdout field.

happy.desc: A FAIL verdict from host B with two parsed findings persists their title, severity, file and description into the committed verdict JSON.

edge.desc: A PASS verdict persists an empty findings array, and finding text is bounded (each field capped) so a runaway provider cannot bloat the artifact.

adversarial.desc: Raw provider stdout never appears in any persisted artifact: the smoke plants a sentinel string in the host output and asserts it is absent from the verdict JSON and the story tree.
